mechanism: Find exact producer-consumer transformations that avoid intermediate tensor traffic during decoder execution

must_keep: frozen target weights and explicit output correctness gate
may_relax: whole-system paper scope when a separable component exists

queries.query: (abs:"LLM" OR abs:"language model" OR abs:"GPU") AND (abs:"inference" OR abs:"kernel") AND (abs:"intermediate tensors" OR abs:"data movement") AND (abs:"fusion" OR abs:"compiler")
queries.purpose: Find recent component-level materialization or layout removal techniques beyond known projection and quantization handoffs
queries.why: Existing PJ01, OP36, EG01, MF19, WP38 and shared-context quantization already target major tensor handoffs; use primary papers to expose a different residual producer-consumer operation, then check source.

open_questions: Which intermediate still exists in the target route?
Can the transformation preserve current rounding boundaries and consumer layout?
What is the exposed-time upper bound, rather than nominal byte savings?
